title: Gradient-Free Methods for Stochastic Convex Optimization with Stochastic Functional Constraints
summary: We develop accelerated gradient-free methods for stochastic convex optimization with constraints defined by expectations. Our batched primal-dual sliding method uses two-point evaluations sharing a random sample and guarantees expected objective error and expected maximum constraint violation at most $\varepsilon$. It achieves $O(\varepsilon^{-1/2})$ sequential oracle rounds for smooth data and $O(d^{1/4}/\varepsilon)$ for nonsmooth data in dimension $d$, recovering the accuracy and dimension dependence of the corresponding unconstrained accelerated methods.
